references.text: God took Abraham from Ur of the Chaldeans, beyond the Euphrates River, and brought him to the land of Canaan.
God's call to Abraham to leave his country and go to the place God would show him, which was Canaan.
God promised Abraham that Sarah would bear him a son, Isaac, and that His covenant would be established with him.
The fulfillment of the promise that God gave Abraham the son Isaac.
God's promise to make Abraham's descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore.
Look to Abraham your father; when he was but one, I called him, blessed him, and made him many.
Nehemiah reminds us that God chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and gave him the name Abraham.
Stephen's speech about how God revealed Himself to Abraham in Mesopotamia and called him to go to a new land.
By faith Abraham obeyed when he was called to go out to the place he would receive as an inheritance, not knowing where he was going.
